phase_1.title: Phase 1 · S&W M500 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .500 S&W Magnum (12.7×41mmSR) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 414 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 414 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 213 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 5-groove bore and accelerates to 602 m/s (3520 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Cylinder Indexing & Operating Impulse

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 5-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the S&W M500 staged for its 24 RPM (five-shot DA/SA) cadence.

zh.headline: 史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮：2003 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 史密斯-韦森 M500 专为发射步枪级 414 MPa 膛压的 .500 S&W 马格南弹而全新设计了庞大不锈钢 X-Frame 底把：五发厚壁转轮与枪口高效顶部制退器协同驯服超过 3,500 焦耳的惊人枪口动能，稳坐量产左轮火力王座。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：S&W M500 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2003 年问世的 史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 由美国史密斯-韦森公司（Smith & Wesson）主导研制，定位为经典的超大底把双动大口径左轮手枪。2003 年问世的 M500 一举打破半个世纪以来 .44 马格南与 .454 卡苏尔的量产左轮动能纪录，其枪口动能甚至超越了 7.62×39mm AK 突击步枪。
史密斯-韦森 M500 专为发射步枪级 414 MPa 膛压的 .500 S&W 马格南弹而全新设计了庞大不锈钢 X-Frame 底把：五发厚壁转轮与枪口高效顶部制退器协同驯服超过 3,500 焦耳的惊人枪口动能，稳坐量产左轮火力王座。 整件装备总长 381 mm（15.0 in · 8.375 in 枪管型）、空重 2.05 kg，成为同期手枪左轮领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2003 年，美国史密斯-韦森公司（Smith & Wesson）推出了划时代的史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮。2003 年问世的 M500 一举打破半个世纪以来 .44 马格南与 .454 卡苏尔的量产左轮动能纪录，其枪口动能甚至超越了 7.62×39mm AK 突击步枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于专为 .500 S&W 设计的特大型 X-Frame 锻造不锈钢底把与双点闭锁转轮，奠定了其在手枪左轮发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 一体式重型锻钢转轮框桥

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 的机械灵魂在于其「特大型不锈钢 X-Frame 双动/单动转轮 · 枪口一体式高效制退器」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，扣动扳机联动拨轮棘爪精准转动转轮巢室并与枪管轴线刚性锁止对齐，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用416R 精密拉丝不锈钢精加工而成。五发无槽/深壁转轮保证相邻弹膛极厚壁厚，抵御 414 MPa 极限膛压，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 采用特大型不锈钢 X-Frame 双动/单动转轮 · 枪口一体式高效制退器。在每个击发周期中，扣动扳机联动拨轮棘爪精准转动转轮巢室并与枪管轴线刚性锁止对齐。借助416R 精密拉丝不锈钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了五发无槽/深壁转轮保证相邻弹膛极厚壁厚，抵御 414 MPa 极限膛压。
acts.focusPartLabel: 转轮闭锁止动块与弹底挡板

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .500 S&W Magnum (12.7×41mmSR) 弹药规格与 213 mm（8.375 in 全长下凸肋不锈钢管 · 5 条右旋 · 1:476 mm），最高工作膛压约 414 MPa，可赋予弹头 602 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,520 J 动能，有效作用距离达 100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，213 mm 5 条右旋不锈钢重管配可换式顶喷膛口制退器，承受 414 MPa 步枪级膛压。同时，标配可换式顶部喷气膛口制退器显著压制 3,520 J 动能引发的猛烈上跳，令其在 24 发/分（五发侧摆双动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 213 毫米身管与 .500 S&W Magnum (12.7×41mmSR) 口径，史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 实现了每秒 602 米的初速与 100 米有效射程。213 mm 5 条右旋不锈钢重管配可换式顶喷膛口制退器，承受 414 MPa 步枪级膛压，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的凹槽式多发旋转弹巢（转轮）与 49 mm 膛轴设计，史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 将单发后坐冲量控制在 13.8 N·s 水平。2.05 kg 全长下配重凸肋枪管与霍格减震橡胶握把缓冲掌心后坐冲击。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-90）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的凹槽式多发旋转弹巢（转轮）与出色的整体工效，2.05 kg 全长下配重凸肋枪管与霍格减震橡胶握把缓冲掌心后坐冲击。欢迎在 BAY-90 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 史密斯-韦森 M500 X-Frame 重型大口径左轮 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the S&W M500
paragraphs: Introduced in 2003 by Smith & Wesson in United States, the Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver emerged as a defining Extra-Large X-Frame Double-Action Revolver. Debuting in 2003 as the most powerful production revolver in the world, the Model 500 generates greater muzzle energy than a 7.62×39mm assault rifle.

Built on a purpose-forged stainless X-Frame to contain 414 MPa rifle-class chamber pressures, the Smith & Wesson Model 500 channels over 3,500 joules of .500 S&W Magnum muzzle energy through a five-shot heavy-walled cylinder and integral top-port muzzle compensator. Measuring 381 mm (15.0 in · 8.375 in Barrel) at an unloaded weight of 2.05 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Handgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2003, Smith & Wesson of United States introduced the Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver. Debuting in 2003 as the most powerful production revolver in the world, the Model 500 generates greater muzzle energy than a 7.62×39mm assault rifle. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Purpose-built stainless X-Frame with dual ball-detent crane lock handles 414 MPa loads — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver sits its Extra-Large Stainless X-Frame DA/SA Five-Shot Cylinder · Integral Muzzle Compensator. Throughout every firing cycle, trigger and hand pawl index the fluted cylinder cleanly into locked alignment with the forcing cone, containing 414 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in precision-machined 416R stainless steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Five-shot thick-walled cylinder maximizes inter-chamber steel safety margin, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver relies on Extra-Large Stainless X-Frame DA/SA Five-Shot Cylinder · Integral Muzzle Compensator. During each cycle, trigger and hand pawl index the fluted cylinder cleanly into locked alignment with the forcing cone. Machined from precision-machined 416R stainless steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Five-shot thick-walled cylinder maximizes inter-chamber steel safety margin.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .500 S&W Magnum (12.7×41mmSR) with 213 mm (8.375 in Full-Underlug Stainless · 5-Groove RH · 1:476 mm), the Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver develops 602 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,520 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 100 meters.

Internally, 213 mm 5-groove RH stainless heavy barrel with interchangeable compensator taming 414 MPa loads. Combined with its 24 RPM (five-shot DA/SA) tempo, Integral upward-porting muzzle compensator tames 3,520 J of muzzle flip, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .500 S&W Magnum (12.7×41mmSR) through its 213 millimeter bore, the Smith & Wesson Model 500 Revolver achieves 602 meters per second and 100 meters of effective reach. 213 mm 5-groove RH stainless heavy barrel with interchangeable compensator taming 414 MPa loads.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 5-round fluted revolving cylinder with a 49 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 13.8 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. 2.05 kg full-underlug barrel mass and Hogue Sorbothane grip cushion peak recoil.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-90), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
